mechanism_claims.claim_text: Peptides 1, 13, 14, 15 and 17 directly bind recombinant influenza hemagglutinin in SPR assays; the source supports HA target engagement, not a resolved peptide epitope map.
direct_assay_types: surface plasmon resonance binding to immobilized hemagglutinin
mechanism_claims.limitations: SPR supports binding and affinity order; it does not alone prove the exact HA epitope or full antiviral mechanism in cells.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: HI assays show source-supported inhibition of influenza hemagglutination for tested H1N1/H3N2 strains.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: peptides with numeric HI titers in Tables 1 and 2
mechanism_claims.limitations: HI data are functional antiviral evidence and should not be over-promoted to a direct molecular epitope assignment.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Neutralization assays in MDCK cells show protection from influenza virus-induced cytopathic effect with source-supported EC50/SI values.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Cell assay supports antiviral activity but not host immune modulation or nucleic-acid interaction mechanisms.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Earlier automated mechanism notes were reduced: the source-reviewed mechanism record keeps HA binding/HI/neutralization evidence and does not promote background immune or nucleic-acid mentions to mechanisms for these peptides.
